comment: Pinned inputs for the SmartRoute OSRM foot-profile extract (ADR-0005, issue #28).
`snapshot` is a Geofabrik dated snapshot, NOT `-latest`: `-latest` moves every day, so a
thesis result derived from it stops being re-derivable the moment it does. Bumping this
date is a deliberate act — record the new one in README.md when you do.
Each region is the smallest Geofabrik extract that contains its city; the script clips it
down to a bounding box derived from the seeded Attraction coordinates.
